text: This recording shows ticket S V one one three nine four, checked on the staging site on the sixteenth of October, twenty twenty-six. We are on the Work Orders page, on the All tab, in Board View.
When the pointer rests on the first card in the Unassigned column, its border turns slightly darker. However, no shadow appears around the card. The shadow value, shown in the caption, reads none.
The next card behaves the same way. The border darkens, but there is still no shadow.
And on a third card, the result is identical. The hover shadow is missing.
To show what is expected, I now remove the card's no-shadow setting, in this browser only, and rest the pointer on the first card again. This time, a soft shadow appears around it.

So the hover style is there, but the no-shadow setting on every card overrides it. Expected: the border darkens and a soft shadow appears, without the card moving. Today, only the border changes, so this check fails.
